description: The plot titled “Hidden State Mean” illustrates the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers in a large language model, comparing three conditions: hidden state mean before the gate (dashed blue line), after the gate (dotted orange line), and of a baseline model (solid green line). The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 23 with linear spacing and integer tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Abs Mean,” ranges from 0 to 4.5 with linear scaling and tick marks at intervals of 1. The dashed blue line (before gate) starts near 0.1 at layer 0, remains relatively flat until layer 15, then rises sharply to about 4.4 by layer 23. The dotted orange line (after gate) stays close to 0 across all layers, with a slight upward trend near layer 20, reaching approximately 0.1. The solid green line (baseline) remains nearly flat and close to 0 throughout, with a minor increase to about 0.08 at the final layer. The legend indicates average values: 0.71 for before gate, 0.05 for after gate, and 0.04 for baseline, reflecting the overall suppression of hidden state magnitude after gating and in the baseline compared to the pre-gate state.
